title: INTERVIEW-4: Pill and mic pattern on every input surface
body:
**Owner:** Product manager
**Trigger:** see below
**Done check:** grep:site/worker.js::pillInput
**Status:** closed

Apply the pill ask bar and voice input to /setup text fields, /pilot form, dashboard and cockpit. Trigger: INTERVIEW-1 live. Closing probe: gaplint rule GL011 finds no bare textarea on a public page.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 221.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
